newsitem.title: USA: Central Sprinkler sees Q3 results lower.
newsitem.headline: Central Sprinkler sees Q3 results lower.

text.p: Central Sprinkler issued a warning Wednesday afternoon that its third quarter earnings are unlikely to meet current expectations because of declining profit margin percentages.

The maker of automatic fire sprikler systems said in a statement that it expects to post third quarter earnings of $0.20 to $0.27 per share. That compares with earnings in its fiscal third quarter of 1996 of $1.3 million, or $0.39 per share.
The company did say however that it expects sales to meet expectations and grow 18 percent compared to the same period last year.

The company said the major reason for the declining profit margin percentage in the third quarter is the increased costs of sprinklers produced at the company's Lansdale plant. Central also said higher costs of its foundry products along with somewhat lower than expected sales prices for most products contributed to the shortfall.

The company said the profit margin decline might be somewhat moderated by anticipated production efficiencies and announced sales price increases effective in the latter part of the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.
